about_the_game:
Chaos, Laughter and Competition: Welcome to the World of Bubblizion!

Bubblizion is a chaotic and competitive party game for 2 to 4 local players. In circular and dangerous arenas, you control a bouncy bubble and must survive unpredictable minigames, push your rivals, and dodge traps, all in fast-paced, intense and hilarious matches.

Play With Friends on the Couch

Bubblizion is perfect for local multiplayer fun. Just plug in the controllers and jump straight into the madness. No long tutorials, all you need is quick reflexes and the will to laugh.

Unpredictable Minigames

The chaos changes every round. One moment you're calmly bouncing, the next you're dodging explosive mines, collapsing walls, or holes opening beneath your feet.

Each minigame has simple rules, but demands quick reflexes and full attention to survive.


Jump, Push, Survive!

Bubblizion is all about laughter, surprises, and friendly rivalry.
Jump, push, survive and try not to be the first bubble to pop.

  • OS *: Windows 7

  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000, AMD Radeon R5, or equivalent
